comparison.objective: Relocate a hot iron and leave it upright on its heel without soleplate contact on the bare mat.
comparison.physical_skill: Safe handle manipulation, orientation control, and stable heel placement.
comparison.success_condition: Iron released and still in the mat's right-hand zone on its heel; hazardous soleplate contact or a fall invalidates the trial.
comparison.reason: Tests safe reorientation and placement of one hot tool, not selective many-body separation through a screen.
